desc: 玄墨石台与冷灰卡面之间的整枝干燥根茎七镜详情套图
leaf: 生晒参整根（炖泡两用干货食材）
name: 玄石仰视浮光晒参整根款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼抢点击，用黑场仰视悬浮把整枝干货的整体形态、躯体比例与须根末端一次交代清楚。
主图一秒法则：把源页的三条主张压缩成三枚空心细线圆章，只留可填卡位，绝不写任何功效短语。
shots.textZone: upper band: three hollow hairline rings, each carrying one short rendered label; product kept in the lower two thirds

shots.intent: 承接下单前的规格疑问，用一张全空的五行表格保留源页参数屏的信息骨架，字段名与数值全部交给商家自填。
shots.textZone: right 58% column: five ruled blank rows with placeholder labels, every value cell left empty; left 42% is the product inset

shots.intent: 给出一个可代入的炖煮使用瞬间，只用蒸汽与入画一角的器物暗示用法，不给配方也不给时长温度。
用三联微距替代源页的三格实物特写，证明外皮环纹、须根束与自身断面这些可实拍验证的形态。
shots.textZone: one short blank label placeholder above each of the three panels, panels themselves kept text-free

shots.intent: 补足第二种日常冲泡用法，用无把直筒杯与无色浅液替代源页的玻璃大罐与酒具符号，避免任何酒类与剂量暗示。
收口降风险：只给相机可验证的干燥形态与自身断面，把源页结尾的会员角标与二维码换成留空的证明卡位。

style.backgroundSystem: two flat planes only across the whole campaign: an infinite ink-graphite sweep #151312 for the dark still-life and benefit screens, and cool putty card stock #EAE9E4 for the information screens; no paper grain, no bamboo, no wood, no landscape photograph
style.direction: cool dark-still-life commerce for dried whole-root produce
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline outline rings and marks in #D09B3C, always left hollow and unprinted; no filled discs, no medical or wellness pictograms
style.lightingSystem: one hard cool key from the upper left with a large negative fill on the right, a thin skimming sweep that traces surface relief, deep falloff into the dark ground, a single clean pooled contact shadow, 5800K-6200K cool grade, never a warm amber cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dried-produce commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ink-graphite ground #151312, cool putty card stock #EAE9E4, one aged-gold hairline accent #D09B3C and one deep berry dot #A6402F; cool neutral daylight grade with no warm amber cast; two-plane studio ground only, an infinite ink-graphite sweep for the dark screens and a sawn-edge cool grey cast-stone tile #24211F for every still life; one hard cool key from the upper left with a large negative fill on the right and a thin skimming sweep along the product surface, deep falloff and one clean pooled contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif only, hairline rules, no serif, no brush calligraphy, no seal script; thin-line icon language in #D09B3C with hollow rings left empty; blank information components only, ruled empty rows, empty tag cards, empty square seal frames; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no serif or calligraphic display type, no rice-paper or bamboo-mat ground, no warm wood table, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no efficacy iconography such as shields, crosses, molecules, organs or human figures.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no warm amber cast on any screen
no mixed fonts, no serif or calligraphic display type
no rice-paper, bamboo-mat or warm wood ground
no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting
no invented numbers, seals, badges or efficacy iconography
style.presentationRules: one single whole unit per screen at stable scale and stable placement; the cut face appears only when it is the product's own; the long axis repeats across the set; no human body, no organ, no molecular graphics; every proof field stays an empty placeholder
style.surfaceSystem: sawn-edge cool grey cast-stone tile #24211F with one chipped corner, matte rather than polished, used as the only table surface for every still-life and macro screen
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for all rendered labels, hairline rules, at most three short lines per screen, no serif, no brush calligraphy, no seal script
